title: Daniel's vision of the four beasts and the Ancient of Days
description: In the first year of King Belshazzar of Babylon, Daniel had a dream where the four winds of heaven broke loose against the sea and four great beasts rose up: a lion with eagle wings, a bear with three ribs in its mouth, a leopard with four wings and four heads, and a terrifying fourth beast with iron teeth and ten horns. A little horn with human eyes and a large mouth grew up among the horns. Then thrones were set in place, the Ancient of Days took his seat, judgment was given, and books were opened, and the fourth beast was killed. Coming with the clouds of heaven, one like a son of man approached and received eternal dominion over all peoples and nations.
